newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck says confident of KMF takeover chances.
newsitem.headline: Merck says confident of KMF takeover chances.

text.p: Chemicals firm Merck KGaA said on Wednesday it was confident it could calm cartel office worries over its plans to take over KMF LaborChemie Handels GmbH.

The cartel office has warned Merck against going ahead with the deal and is considering banning the takeover outright, amid fears that it would strengthen Merck's already dominant position in the market for laboratory reagents.
But Merck, which announced plans to buy KMF last October, took news of the monopoly fears calmly.

"We are of the opinion that we can dispel the concerns of the cartel office," a spokesman said. Merck could prove that its position in laboratory reagent manufacture and trading in Germany was not dominant, he said.
Merck, which has annual sales of around 1.6 billion marks in the laboratory segment, plans to combine KMF with its subsidiary Bender & Hobein.
The deadline for a final decision from the cartel office and a response from Merck has since been extended until April 24.
